SELECT COUNT(*) AS leads, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN next_followup_at < NOW() AND lead_status NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN next_followup_at >= NOW() AND next_followup_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND lead_status NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN next_followup_at >= NOW() AND next_followup_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 7 DAY AND lead_status NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS upcoming FROM crm_lead
owner_id = #{owner}

SELECT l.id, l.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, p.project_name, l.lead_status, l.next_followup_at FROM crm_lead l JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = l.enterprise_id LEFT JOIN crm_project p ON p.id = l.project_id
AND l.owner_id = #{owner} AND l.lead_status NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') AND l.next_followup_at IS NOT NULL AND l.next_followup_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 7 DAY
ORDER BY l.next_followup_at, l.id LIMIT 20
